title: Proper Red Lantern models
desc: The jar's Red Lantern made proper, 604-style: smooth crimson glass, mixed finishes by part (gold, black steel, obsidian), new silhouettes. Every take has the claw mark (three slashes in a ring) on a lens standing out of the front; the slashes light with the charge.

takes.name: Y cradle
takes.facts: the jar's shape made proper: rounded-square crimson column in the gold Y cradle and arch, top ring; claw lens on a gold neck

takes.name: Ruby pinch
takes.facts: 604 A1's pinched column in crimson glass with gold (M1 ruby + gold); claw lens at the waist

takes.name: Steel cage
takes.facts: round crimson glass in a black-steel cage with steel collars and a gold neck (M3)

takes.name: Clutched heart
takes.facts: crimson glass orb gripped by three black-steel claws on an obsidian pedestal (M2)

takes.name: Rage spire
takes.facts: two obsidian-framed chambers under a jagged crown of uneven tapered spikes, gold trims

takes.name: Blood lamp
takes.facts: 604 B3's hourglass in crimson; long thin blood streaks run down from the top ring
